synthetic.label: Synthetic Baseline
synthetic.description: Provisional N-D-C values derived from PDI boundary scoring, Mirova feasibility data, and public agroforestry sources. Covers eight phases from in-situ origin through market delivery across the Senegal agroforestry ecosystem (shea, moringa, mango, groundnut, native forest carbon).

phase_meta.name: In-Situ Origin
phase_meta.transformation: Pre-commercial state: natural forests, primary and secondary plantations (native forest + moringa), shea and mango trees, groundnut fields. GGW and PAPSEN sites across Groundnut Basin, Shea Zone, and Great Green Wall corridors.
phase_meta.sites: GGW A1-A4, PAPSEN, Shea Zone (far south-east), Groundnut Basin (Kaolack, Fatick, Thiès, Diourbel, Louga)

phase_meta.name: Harvest + Nursery Establishment
phase_meta.transformation: Seasonal collection of shea fruits, moringa leaves/pods/seeds, mangoes, groundnuts; concurrent nursery seeding and seedling propagation for native forest restoration.
phase_meta.actor: Smallholder farmers, collectors, nursery managers, Serious Shea cooperatives
phase_meta.opacity_reason: Informal harvesting practices; no centralised harvest records at cooperative level

phase_meta.name: Primary Processing (Shelling/Sorting)
phase_meta.transformation: Raw materials shelled, hulled, and sorted; waste streams (shells, husks) separated for biogas and fertilizer inputs; seedlings transplanted to plantation sites.
phase_meta.actor: Serious Shea Processing Centres (18 multi-functional Clean Energy Processing Centres)

phase_meta.name: Drying, QC + Plantation Care
phase_meta.transformation: Sorted materials sun-dried or mechanically dried to specification; quality control grading; plantation crews care for transplanted saplings (watering, weeding, protection).
phase_meta.actor: Processing centres, certifiers, plantation management crews

phase_meta.name: Transformation (Grinding/Pressing/Biogas)
phase_meta.transformation: Moringa leaves ground to powder; shea kernels roasted and churned to paste; groundnuts cold/hot pressed for oil; waste streams converted to biogas/syngas, biochars, and organic fertilizer.
phase_meta.opacity_reason: Private commercial processing; limited published throughput data for individual centres

phase_meta.name: Refining + Export Preparation
phase_meta.transformation: Shea paste steamed and fat-extracted to raw shea butter; fractionated into shea sterin (confectionery) and shea olein (personal care); moringa and groundnut oils packaged in bulk; export documentation prepared.
phase_meta.actor: 2 Shea Butter Processing Clusters, export logistics providers

phase_meta.name: Certification + Carbon Registry
phase_meta.transformation: Agricultural products certified (organic, fair-trade equivalent); carbon credits verified and registered via Acorn programme and EP Carbon/Mirova pathway; Sustainability Linked Bond (SLB) structuring.
phase_meta.actor: EP Carbon, Mirova, Acorn registry, third-party auditors

phase_meta.name: Market Delivery
phase_meta.transformation: Certified shea butter and fractions delivered to cosmetics and food industry buyers; moringa products to nutraceutical and food markets; carbon credits traded on Voluntary Carbon Market; groundnut products to domestic/export food markets.
phase_meta.actor: International cosmetics manufacturers, food industry buyers, VCM brokers, WAEMU financial markets

synthetic.notes: Natural/planted trees and seeds in situ → pre-commercial biomass state. Land cover: 41.92% open forest across all sites (Mirova remote sensing). Shea site 70.33% forest cover; GGW A4 98.28% herbaceous (severely degraded baseline).
synthetic.scope_source: Not provided — requires separate LCA input

synthetic.notes: On-tree materials and in-soil seeds → harvested raw commodities + seedlings planted. Custody transfers from GGW/PAPSEN/private landowners to Serious Shea cooperatives and nursery managers. Informal harvest volumes; no published cooperative-level records.

Raw harvested materials → shelled/sorted commodities + separated waste streams. Shells and husks diverted to biogas/fertilizer input. 18 multi-functional Clean Energy Processing Centres handle primary processing across PAPSEN and GGW sites.

Wet/unsorted materials → dried/graded commodities meeting export specification. Concurrent: saplings transition from nursery to established plantation under plantation care protocols. Quality control gates here.

metrics.unit: kg dried/graded material / ha plantation area

synthetic.notes: BOTTLENECK PHASE. Dried inputs → moringa powder/oil, shea paste, groundnut oil, biogas/syngas, biochars, organic fertilizer. The co-production of energy (biogas/syngas) and fertilizer alongside primary commodities creates a complex multi-output phase with limited published throughput data.

metrics.unit: kg processed commodity / m3 biogas produced

synthetic.notes: Shea paste → raw shea butter (steam extraction) → shea sterin (confectionery) + shea olein (personal care) via fractionation. Moringa and groundnut oils bulk-packaged. Export documentation prepared. 2 Shea Butter Processing Clusters handle shea fractionation.

metrics.unit: kg refined product / kg paste input

synthetic.notes: Agricultural products certified (deforestation-free, zero-carbon, beyond-fairtrade standard). Carbon credits verified and registered via Acorn programme (EP Carbon/Mirova pathway). Annual tCO2 at steady state: 2,692 (low) / 3,330 (mid) / 4,015 (high) tCO2/yr (Mirova v1.1). SLB and nature credit structuring.
synthetic.scope_source: Mirova Shea Senegal Feasibility Report v1.1 (EP Carbon due diligence)
synthetic.scope_quality: Partial — carbon sequestration data from Mirova; operational emissions not quantified

synthetic.notes: Certified commodities delivered to international buyers; carbon credits traded on VCM. Annual credit revenue at steady state: $313,500 (low) / $387,750 (mid) / $467,500 (high) per year (Mirova v1.1). 30-year total: $8.0M-$11.9M. Groundnut products to domestic food markets and SONACOS.
synthetic.scope_source: Mirova Shea Senegal Feasibility Report v1.1
synthetic.scope_quality: Partial — revenue projections from Mirova; market price basis not fully disclosed

synthetic.bottleneck_description: Phase 4 (Transformation/Biogas, balance 65) is the primary bottleneck: the co-production of energy and commodities in 18 distributed processing centres creates structural opacity with no published throughput data. Phases 1 and 5 are secondary bottlenecks due to informal harvesting records and limited refining data respectively.
synthetic.interpretation: An 8-phase multi-commodity agroforestry and carbon ecosystem chain with a system balance of 78%. The processing transformation layer (Phase 4) is the structural weak point. The certification and market delivery phases (6-7) are the strongest, anchored by the Acorn/EP Carbon registry and Mirova due diligence. Sovereign risk (Moody's triple downgrade Oct 2025) adds context for bond-linked ecosystem finance instruments.
